about: Clinicly is a fictional brand. Every clinic, clinician, patient, appointment, visit, visit note and reminder in this file is invented, and no name is meant to be a real person. Ids are stable and are never reused or renumbered; every id from the direction round (cl-01, cn-01 to cn-03, pt-0001 to pt-0008, apt-0038 to apt-0044, rm-0041 to rm-0043, sl-1112-*) keeps its meaning. Times are fixed sample times, not live data. Contact addresses use example.test and phone numbers are 555-01xx. The pictures in the Clinicly brand book are drawn from this file; they are illustrations, not evidence that any product is accessible. FableBook maps each case to a Scenario and each flow to a Journey and keeps the original ids.

sampleToday.note: The sample time is 9:35 AM (the direction round showed 9:05 AM; it moved so that the 9:00 AM appointment apt-0038, which is Completed, has ended). Clocks go back at 2:00 AM on Sunday 2026-11-01 (EDT to EST), so the local time 1:00 to 2:00 AM happens twice that day.

display.time: A time is shown in the clinic's own time zone, as written in the start value (the offset in the string is that clinic's offset on that date). The zone is named once per screen, and abbreviated (EDT, EST, CDT) beside any time that could be read two ways, or when the viewer's zone differs from the clinic's.
display.en: 12-hour time with AM or PM, abbreviated weekday and month (Fri, Oct 30), Western digits.
display.ar: 24-hour time, the day and month in Arabic words, Western digits as the default. Arabic-Indic digits appear once, as a labeled example. Latin names, references such as APT-0042 and times are isolated left-to-right runs inside the right-to-left line.
display.duration: A duration is whole minutes, shown as "30 min".
display.missing: A missing value is absent or null in this file, never an empty string. The screen shows a short plain phrase for it (for example "No phone number"), never a blank.
display.names: Matching display names are told apart by the patient identifier (CLY- and six digits).
display.flows: A flow step names the case on screen when the person acts (caseId), the action, what the person sees as a result (expected), the values on that screen (changing) and the values right after the action (outcome). The next step's screen shows those outcome values. A choice or typed text is already part of the screen it was made on, so the chosen time is marked on the screen where it was chosen. A step that only reads has an empty outcome.

visitNotes.text: Routine check. No concerns raised. Patient asked about booking the next visit in the fall.
Talked about the new work schedule and regular meals. Patient will bring a list of questions next time.
Follow-up after the September visit. Patient reports things are steady. Next visit to be booked online.
Short visit. Paperwork reviewed and filed. Nothing further needed today.

First visit in this clinic. Went over the family contact details, the usual pharmacy and the preferred way to be reached. Patient said mornings work best for appointments and that a text message is the easiest reminder. We talked about how the clinic keeps records, who can read them and how to ask for a copy. Patient had questions about the online booking page and how to move an appointment. They were shown where Reschedule is. Patient agreed to bring any earlier paperwork to the next visit and to say so if anything on file is out of date.

jobs.words: Help me find a time that is really free, book it, and trust that it is booked.
I just need to know who is next.

steps.expected: The date step opens with Ana Reyes chosen.
The open times for that day appear.
The time is marked and the review opens.
The button says Booking while the request is sent.
The answer comes back and the appointment is booked.
The appointment APT-0060 is Scheduled for 9:30 AM.

flows.title: The time was taken before confirming

steps.expected: The time is marked and the review opens.
The button says Booking while the request for 9:30 AM is sent.
The answer comes back: that time was just taken.
The page says that time was just taken, shows 9:30 AM as taken and keeps the other details.
The new time is marked and the review opens.
The button says Booking while the request for 10:00 AM is sent. The reference is the same.
The answer comes back and the appointment is booked.
APT-0061 is Scheduled for 10:00 AM.
